ticker: ▲ HONDIUS DOCKS TENERIFE; REPATRIATION FLIGHTS UNDERWAY WITH STRICT BIOSECURITY MEASURES
▲ NO NEW INFECTIONS REPORTED SINCE ISOLATION MEASURES IMPLEMENTED ABOARD MV HONDIUS
▲ FRENCH NATIONAL DEVELOPS SYMPTOMS ON REPATRIATION FLIGHT — ALL 5 FR PAX PLACED STRICT ISOLATION BICHAT
► 152 PAX/CONTACTS UNDER MONITORING IN TENERIFE AS MULTINATIONAL REPATRIATION OPERATION COMPLETES
► UK ARMY HISTORIC FIRST: PARATROOPERS PARACHUTE ONTO TRISTAN DA CUNHA — OXYGEN CRITICAL, NO AIRSTRIP
► 18 US/UK-RESIDENT PAX → OFFUTT AFB → NEBRASKA NQU; NONE POSITIVE AS OF SAT; FINAL AUS FLIGHT MON PM
► ACTING CDC DIR BHATTACHARYA CRITICISED FOR UNCLEAR RESPONSES ON PAX MONITORING PROCEDURES
► HONDIUS TO SAIL ROTTERDAM POST-EVACUATION FOR FULL DECONTAMINATION WITH 30 SKELETON CREW ABOARD
// WHO: GLOBAL PUBLIC RISK LOW; ANDES ONLY HANTAVIRUS HUMAN-TRANSMISSIBLE — 'THIS IS NOT ANOTHER COVID'
// SPAIN HEALTH MINISTER: MULTINATIONAL OPERATION UNPRECEDENTED; NO CONTACT WITH LOCAL TENERIFE POPULATION

sites.name: M/V HONDIUS
sites.country: TENERIFE / CANARY ISLANDS — EVACUATION IN PROGRESS
sites.desc: Vessel docked Granadilla port ~05:30 local 10 May; 94 passengers evacuated day 1, final 2 flights depart Monday afternoon per Spain Health Minister Garcia. No new infections reported since isolation measures implemented. 30 skeleton crew + Dutch nurse to sail vessel to Rotterdam post-evacuation for full decontamination.

sites.name: USHUAIA / ARGENTINA ROUTE
sites.desc: Index case (Dutch male, 70, died 11 Apr) took 4-month road trip 27 Nov 2025–1 Apr 2026 through Chile, Uruguay, Argentina before boarding. Argentine health ministry published detailed route map 06 May; Malbrán Institute trapping/testing rodents along route. Argentina reports ~101 hantavirus infections since Jun 2025.

sites.name: SAINT HELENA
sites.desc: 30 passengers disembarked 24 Apr including Dutch index male's body and Dutch widow (later died Johannesburg) and Swiss confirmed male. UKHSA contact-tracing 30 disembarkees plus 82 pax and 6 crew from 25 Apr Airlink St Helena–Johannesburg flight. Four Tristan da Cunha islanders also transited St Helena aboard Hondius per UK minister Doughty.

sites.name: JOHANNESBURG
sites.desc: Case 2 (Dutch widow, 69, PCR+) died Johannesburg hospital 26 Apr — confirmed Andes virus fatality. Case 3 (British guide Martin Anstee, 56, PCR+) treated at Johannesburg ICU; improving, transferred Netherlands. A second British national confirmed PCR-positive 08 May in a South Africa health facility. NICD contact-traced 65+ contacts from 25 Apr Airlink flight.

sites.name: AMSTERDAM / NIJMEGEN / ROTTERDAM
sites.desc: British Case 3 (Anstee) transferred to Netherlands after improving in South Africa. Dutch crew member (41, confirmed) treated at Radboud UMC Nijmegen. Netherlands lab PCR-confirmed German woman died of Andes virus. MV Hondius to sail Rotterdam post-Tenerife for full disinfection with skeleton crew of 30 + Dutch nurse aboard.

sites.name: MANCHESTER / WIRRAL / LONDON
sites.desc: 22 British nationals evacuated Tenerife; 20 flew Titan Airways charter to Manchester, now at Arrowe Park Hospital (Wirral) for up to 72-hr clinical assessment + testing, then 45-day self-isolation. UKHSA: 3 British cases total — 2 PCR-confirmed (SA/NL) + 1 suspected Tristan da Cunha. British Army parachute drop on Tristan da Cunha (9 May) in support of suspected case there.

sites.name: PARIS / LE BOURGET
sites.desc: 5 French Hondius passengers repatriated by medical flight 10 May, landing Le Bourget ~16:30. One developed symptoms on the repatriation flight — all 5 placed strict isolation, transferred to Bichat Hospital Paris for 72-hr hospitalisation + full evaluation, then 45-day home quarantine. PM Lecornu confirmed issuing isolation decree for close contacts.

sites.name: ZURICH
sites.desc: PCR-confirmed male passenger disembarked St Helena 24 Apr via South Africa and Qatar; symptoms onset 01 May, tested positive Andes virus 05 May at University Hospital Zurich, confirmed 06 May. Wife (also on trip) asymptomatic and isolating; Swiss contact tracing ongoing.

sites.name: BERLIN / DÜSSELDORF
sites.desc: German woman died on board 02 May (fever/malaise onset 28 Apr, pneumonia); Netherlands postmortem PCR confirmed Andes virus. Asymptomatic 65-year-old German contact evacuated 06 May returned Düsseldorf — tested NEGATIVE. German nationals repatriated via Dutch charter from Tenerife (10 May Sunday flight). RKI contact tracing active.

sites.name: ALICANTE
sites.desc: 32-year-old woman (seated 2 rows behind deceased Dutch woman on 25 Apr Airlink flight) returned first PCR NEGATIVE at Centro Nacional de Microbiología. Awaiting second confirmatory PCR; if also negative, transfers to Gómez Ulla Military Hospital Madrid.

sites.name: TENERIFE
sites.desc: Hondius docked Granadilla port 10 May; multinational repatriation operation underway with 152 passengers/contacts under monitoring. No new infections reported since isolation measures implemented; passengers sprayed with disinfectant on tarmac. 358 Guardia Civil agents involved; Spanish inspectors confirmed no rodents found aboard vessel.

sites.name: MADRID
sites.desc: 14 Spanish passengers landed Torrejón de Ardoz military airport, transported to Gómez Ulla Military Hospital. No Spanish nationals showing symptoms at disembarkation. PCR on arrival + Day 7; twice-daily temperature monitoring; individual rooms, no visitors.

sites.name: BARCELONA
sites.desc: Two Barcelona contacts monitored: (1) South African woman (asymptomatic flight contact of Dutch deceased) spent ~1 week here before returning South Africa — confirmed asymptomatic. (2) Barcelona-resident woman identified 09 May as flight contact after mid-flight seat change; asymptomatic, under official monitoring per Spanish Health Ministry.

sites.name: TRISTAN DA CUNHA
sites.desc: UKHSA confirmed suspected case 08 May: British male islander aboard Hondius during 13–15 Apr stop; symptoms onset 28 Apr, stable in isolation on island. RAF A400M emergency airdrop 09 May: 6 paratroopers + 2 military clinicians parachuted onto island's golf course delivering 3.3 tonnes medical supplies — first-ever UK military humanitarian parachute deployment.

sites.name: SINGAPORE
sites.desc: CLEARED 09 May: Both male residents (aged 67 and 65) tested NEGATIVE for hantavirus including Andes virus via multiple PCR samples — Singapore CDA confirmed. Both had disembarked Hondius at St Helena and traveled on 25 Apr Airlink flight. Monitoring continues through full incubation window.

sites.name: ONTARIO
sites.desc: Two Ontario residents self-isolating — Hondius passengers who returned home early, asymptomatic. Canadian repatriation flight departed Tenerife 10 May (second nationality after Spain to evacuate). PHAC coordinating monitoring per 07 May government statement.

sites.name: QUEBEC
sites.desc: One Quebec resident self-isolating — not a Hondius passenger but shared homebound flight with two Canadian Hondius disembarkees. Asymptomatic; PHAC monitoring active.

sites.name: ARIZONA
sites.desc: ADHS monitoring one returning passenger under 42-day observation. Asymptomatic as of 10 May. CDC notified ADHS 05 May; public risk assessed as very low. Part of domestic US monitoring cohort across 6 states.

sites.name: CALIFORNIA
sites.desc: CDPH monitoring one returned Hondius traveler via daily temperature checks and symptom assessment. A second California resident transited Tenerife to Nebraska NQU via CDC/HHS biocontainment charter. No California residents reported ill as of 10 May. Acting CDC Director Bhattacharya criticised for unclear responses on monitoring procedures for returning passengers per The Daily Beast.

sites.name: GEORGIA
sites.desc: Georgia DPH monitoring two residents who returned from Hondius. Both in good health with no signs of infection as of 10 May. Following CDC recommendations. Part of domestic US monitoring cohort across 6 states.

sites.name: TEXAS
sites.desc: Texas DSHS monitoring two returning Hondius passengers. Both asymptomatic as of 10 May. Part of domestic US monitoring cohort across 6 states.

sites.name: VIRGINIA
sites.desc: VDH monitoring one returning Hondius passenger. Asymptomatic. CDC classified response as Level-3; Emergency Operations Center activated. Six states — AZ, CA, GA, TX, VA, NJ — monitoring at least 9 early-disembarkees or contacts.

sites.name: NEW JERSEY
sites.desc: NJ DOH monitoring two individuals potentially exposed to a Hondius passenger post-disembarkation during air travel. Neither symptomatic as of 10 May. Exposure occurred during air travel abroad; residents were not Hondius passengers themselves.

sites.name: NEBRASKA
sites.desc: Nebraska Medicine / UNMC National Quarantine Unit (NQU) activated for 18 inbound passengers (17 Americans + 1 UK-resident British national) via Offutt AFB — US flight departed Tenerife ~21:30 local. None of the Americans tested positive as of Saturday (CDC). After brief NQU assessment, passengers may opt for 42-day home self-monitoring with daily health department contact.

sites.name: UTAH
sites.desc: Utah DHHS confirmed at least one Utah resident among the Americans aboard MV Hondius. Person asymptomatic; disembarked Tenerife with federal escort to Nebraska NQU for evaluation. No Utah residents monitored at home as of 10 May.

sites.name: MANILA
sites.desc: 38 Filipino crew members aboard Hondius; Philippines DOH confirmed none currently ill as of 10 May. Skeleton crew of ~30 (predominantly Filipino) will remain aboard to sail vessel to Rotterdam with Dutch nurse. Monitoring continues through incubation window.

sites.name: DUBLIN / BALDONNELL
sites.desc: Irish passengers repatriated 10 May via Defence Forces Dassault Falcon 6X government jet to Baldonnell — first medevac mission for the aircraft (acquired Dec 2025, €53M). Irish Dept of Health National Incident Management Team stood up; coordinating with ECDC, HSE. No symptomatic cases reported.

sites.name: PRAIA
sites.desc: Hondius anchored Praia 03–06 May; departed 19:15 local 06 May for Tenerife. Three medevac patients evacuated 06 May — two flew Amsterdam (hazmat teams at Schiphol), third plane made unscheduled Gran Canaria refueling stop after Morocco refused permission + medical equipment malfunction. Cape Verde unable to handle full passenger evacuation.

sites.name: COPENHAGEN
sites.desc: Danish Patient Safety Authority confirmed one Danish national was aboard MV Hondius. Person returned to Denmark end of April, self-isolating, no symptoms, not in close contact with any confirmed case. Monitoring active per national protocol.

sites.name: BRUSSELS
sites.desc: Belgian nationals repatriated via Dutch charter from Tenerife (10 May Sunday flight alongside NL/DE/GR nationals). Belgian federal health authorities coordinating with ECDC. No symptomatic cases reported.

sites.name: WELLINGTON
sites.desc: NZ nationals among passengers on final Australia-led repatriation flight departing Tenerife Monday afternoon. NZ Ministry of Health coordinating contact tracing; no symptomatic cases reported.

sites.name: STOCKHOLM
sites.desc: Sweden confirmed among 12+ countries monitoring Hondius nationals who disembarked. Swedish Public Health Agency (Folkhälsomyndigheten) coordinating; no symptomatic cases reported.

sites.name: ANKARA
sites.desc: Turkish nationals evacuated Tenerife 10 May (Sunday flight sequence: ES → CA → NL/DE/BE/GR → TR → FR → UK → US per Spain minister Garcia). Turkish Ministry of Health coordinating; no symptomatic cases reported.

sites.name: BASSETERRE
sites.desc: Saint Kitts and Nevis confirmed among 12+ countries monitoring nationals who disembarked MV Hondius. Local health authorities monitoring; no symptomatic cases reported.

sites.name: ATHENS
sites.desc: Greek nationals repatriated via Dutch charter from Tenerife (10 May Sunday flight alongside NL/DE/BE nationals). Greek Ministry of Health coordinating with ECDC; no symptomatic cases reported.

sites.name: WARSAW
sites.desc: Polish nationals confirmed aboard Hondius per ECDC briefing. Polish Chief Sanitary Inspectorate coordinating with ECDC; no symptomatic cases reported.

sites.name: LISBON
sites.desc: Portuguese nationals confirmed aboard Hondius per ECDC briefing. DGS Portugal coordinating with ECDC; no symptomatic cases reported.

sites.name: SYDNEY / CANBERRA
sites.desc: Australia sending repatriation plane for final Tenerife flight Monday afternoon covering Australian, New Zealand, and several Asian-country nationals. At least one Australian national had disembarked at Saint Helena 24 Apr and returned home. Australian health authorities monitoring; no symptomatic cases reported.
